_about: Pell, the Kirru party hero (docs/kb/art/characters/pell.md). Body block and face sliders from §1 and §9, relative to the MakeHuman donor's own form (ADR 0021: 1.0 / 0.0 = unchanged). Keys starting with '_' are read by build_pell.py and the pell_* modules, not by bb_params.
name: pell

_proportions._about: pell.md §1 numbers that are not bb_params inputs (the stand, the crest heights, the age read).

_kirru._about: pell.md §9: the Kirru head warp (pell_head.kirru_warp), read only by build_pell.py and the pell_* modules (the shared bb_params reader is unchanged). Starting values; the as-built values are these.

shape_gain._about: Look-dev review: the 40 shared shapes scaled on the Kirru head (its brow and lids are flat, so the shared deltas read faint); unlisted shapes 1.

otter_head._about: M3-CHR-506 look-dev (review): the Kirru head surface the donor head's skin is projected onto (pell_head.KirruWarp). Centres are metres from the eyes' plane (x left, y back, z up: Blender's frame, the donor eye's y and z as the origin), radii metres. A broad, low cranium; a short broad muzzle flowing out of the skull line with the nose pad and the whisker pads on it; full jowls and a chin under the mouth into a thick neck (`neck_scale`: the neck widened at the notch and under the jaw). The skin moves along rays from `centre` (one-to-one), smoothed over `smooth_m`, keeping `detail_keep` of the donor's own relief away from the eyes and the mouth. The eyes, the mouth and the ears ride rigidly to their spots.

eye_round._about: M3-CHR-506 second look-dev pass (pell_head.KirruWarp.round_eyes): the lid opening scaled about the eye's centre, `width` along the fissure and `height` across it, inside the lid field radius region[0], fading out by region[1]; the eye frames take the same scale.

ear_shape._about: M3-CHR-506 second look-dev pass (pell_head.KirruWarp._ear_shape): the ear drawn round (ear_round 1 = as tall as it is wide) and laid closer to the skull (ear_flat scales its depth off it).

_costume._about: pell.md §3-§4 (pell_costume.py): sheet measures are his own (metres, not scaled). M1-CHR-14 lines: the mantle's arm edge `mantle_arm_drop_m` below the shoulder joint with a `mantle_arm_band_m` blend band (`mantle_arm_share` on the upper arm), the cord under the left arm `cord_underarm_drop_m` below the joint, the neck edge `mantle_neck_clear_m` off the neck.

_staff._about: pell.md §3, §4.1 #7: the fishing-staff, held in the left hand (pell_props.py).

_shell._about: pell.md §3, §4.1 #3: the name-shell on its throat cord, rigid to DEF-spine.004 (pell_props.py).

_fur._about: pell.md §5 (pell_fur.py, pell_textures.py): the fur colours and its flow, the silhouette fringe.

_crest._about: pell.md §5: the crest of fine heron feathers (pell_fur.crest), head-rigid, two shape keys.

_whiskers._about: pell.md §5: whiskers on the pads, in the Head object (pell_fur.whiskers).

_brow._about: pell.md §5: the brow tufts, in the Head object (pell_fur.brow_tufts).

_webs._about: pell.md §3: the webbing between the fingers to the middle knuckle, blended between the two neighbouring finger bones (build_pell.webs).
